source.title: NASA POWER daily meteorological context
source.note: Historical daily model/reanalysis skin and air temperature, precipitation, 10 m wind and surface pressure. Not current weather or local water detection.
source.license: NASA POWER openly available data; acknowledge NASA POWER and upstream model products.

limitations: These are historical daily model/reanalysis values, not a live instrument feed or weather forecast.
The native meteorological grid is 0.5° latitude × 0.625° longitude; local rocks, shade, coastlines and a 32 km terrain window are not resolved.
Daily mean wind is not a gust measurement or evidence of a storm; precipitation does not identify standing water, ice or flooding.
Temperature fields have different physical heights: TS is skin temperature and T2M is air temperature at 2 m.
Daily mean extrema are not instantaneous or day/night extremes. LST means Local Solar Time.
An incomplete precipitation series has only an available-day sum, not a complete-period precipitation total.
